# CURVD

> CURVD manufactures premium soft reusable earplugs designed for sleep, travel, work focus, sensory relief, live music, and self-care with customizable styles and accessories.

CURVD offers a comprehensive range of hearing protection products including the flagship CURVD Live™ for concerts, CURVD CLIQ™ with swappable covers for style customization, and CURVD Everyday™ for daily comfort. The brand emphasizes soft, reusable construction with noise reduction ratings (NRR) and targets diverse use cases from parenting stress relief to motorcycle use.

## Key Topics

- CURVD Earplugs
